value.name: Villager
value.schedule: home → park → shops → inn; sleeps at night; lantern at night

value.name: Weapon Vendor
value.service: sells weapons (A +1..+100 any class; S worn→legendary by gnomes), buys anything

value.name: Item Vendor / General Store
value.service: A: materials, pet food, formulas, iron lamps, gliders, boats, sugar cubes, flasks; S: flasks (1 coin), bombs, sugar cubes, 1 pet food/day, legendary rings/amulets after 4 gnomes

value.name: Identifier (A) / Analyst (S)
value.service: identifies leftovers for a fee by level & quality; may roll +1 tier; does not buy

value.name: Innkeeper
value.service: 18:00-06:00 → 07:00; A free; S 10 coins + re-roll daily missions; beds heal

value.name: Adapter
value.service: re-level item to player power for platinum coins; lowering free

value.name: Flight Master
value.service: buy flight points (min 100 coins, scales with distance, permanent); fly to undiscovered points; free to friends; drops you with temporary glider; 5-30 s flight

value.name: Gem Trader
value.service: roaming gnome: sells emerald 100 / sapphire 200 / ruby 400 / diamond 800; buys anything; fights nearby enemies

value.name: Gnome Supplier
value.service: captive (4/land); rescue raises shop stock rarity; drops rewards at your feet

value.behaviour: roam and fight monsters like players; some hostile (rarity-coloured names)
value.name: Adventurer group
